headline: Romania's Inflation Has Fallen, but Remains the Highest in the EU. What Eurostat Data Shows
summary: Eurostat data show EU annual inflation rose to 3% in July from 2.9% in June. Romania again recorded the highest inflation rate in the bloc.
why: Eurostat publishes the harmonised inflation figures used to compare price trends across EU member states and to assess European Central Bank policy. Inflation differences between members affect bond spreads and currency views.
